# State machines

<!-- Generated by `npm run machines:export` from src/lib/machines/index.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every status in the ERP that changes over time, with every move it allows. The server refuses any other move inside the
same transaction as the write and answers **409** with `{ error, machine, from, to, allowed: [{ to, event }] }`, so a
screen, an app or an agent always learns what it can do instead. `set` is a person choosing the status; the other events
are named actions (Finalize, Refund, Book with TCS) or the server's own runs (Shopify, the website, the five-minute tick).

## Order

`orders/<id>.status` · states: `Pending` (Pending), `In Progress` (In Progress), `Completed` (Completed), `Cancelled` (Cancelled), `Refunded` (Refunded) · final: `Refunded`

| From | To | Event | Only when | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Completed`, `Cancelled` | `Pending` | set | not invoiced | reopen or send back |
| `Pending`, `Completed`, `Cancelled` | `In Progress` | set | not invoiced |  |
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Cancelled` | `Completed` | set | not invoiced | ticks every piece |
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Completed` | `Cancelled` | set | not invoiced |  |
| `Pending` | `In Progress` | pieces |  | every piece has a karigar |
| `Pending`, `In Progress` | `Completed` | pieces | not invoiced | the last piece ticked |
| `Completed` | `In Progress` | pieces | not invoiced | a piece unticked |
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Completed` | `Completed` | finalize |  | Finalize & invoice |
| `Completed` | `Pending` | undoInvoice |  | the invoice deleted; back to its status before (or Pending) |
| `Completed` | `In Progress` | undoInvoice |  |  |
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Completed` | `Refunded` | refund |  | Refund: stock back, money out; the only way to Refunded |
| `Pending`, `In Progress` | `Completed` | delivered |  | the website or Shopify says the parcel arrived |
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Completed` | `Completed` | shipped |  | Shopify shipped it |
| `Pending`, `In Progress` | `Cancelled` | lapse |  | a website order whose transfer never came |
| `Pending`, `In Progress`, `Completed` | `Cancelled` | shopifyCancel | not invoiced | cancelled or returned on Shopify with nothing paid |

## Repair

`repairs/<id>.status` · states: `received` (In the shop), `ready` (Ready), `collected` (Collected), `cancelled` (Cancelled)

| From | To | Event | Only when | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ready`, `cancelled`, `collected` | `received` | set |  | back in the shop (undo) |
| `received`, `collected` | `ready` | set |  |  |
| `received`, `ready` | `collected` | set | nothing owed (under 1 rupee is settled) |  |
| `received`, `ready` | `cancelled` | set |  |  |

## Payment link

`payment_links/<token>.state` · states: `open` (Waiting for payment), `paid` (Paid), `expired` (Expired), `attention` (Paid, needs you) · final: `paid`

| From | To | Event | Only when | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open`, `expired`, `attention` | `paid` | paid |  | Safepay says paid: recorded once, by Card |
| `open` | `expired` | expire |  | 30 days unpaid; still checked for a late payment |
| `open`, `expired` | `attention` | unapplied |  | paid, but its order or invoice is closed: the owner decides |

## Website order

`online_orders/<id>.state` · states: `pending` (Waiting for the shop), `confirming` (Being confirmed), `confirmed` (Confirmed), `declined` (Declined) · final: `confirmed`, `declined`

| From | To | Event | Only when | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pending` | `confirming` | claim |  | a person pressed Confirm (held 2 minutes) |
| `confirming` | `confirming` | claim |  | a claim older than 2 minutes is taken over |
| `confirming` | `confirmed` | confirm |  | the ERP order is made |
| `confirming` | `pending` | release |  | making the order failed |
| `pending` | `declined` | decline |  |  |

## TCS booking

`orders/<id>.tcsBooking` · states: `none` (Not booked), `pending` (Booking…), `booked` (Booked), `cancelled` (Booking cancelled)

| From | To | Event | Only when | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `none`, `cancelled` | `pending` | book | order not Cancelled or Refunded | held 90 seconds against a second booking |
| `pending` | `booked` | booked |  | TCS gave the consignment number |
| `pending` | `none` | failed |  |  |
| `booked` | `cancelled` | cancel | the parcel has not left |  |
